libdxfrwSourceProfileRecheck.method: Temporary local adapter-test instrumentation imported the witness through dx_iface, compared the GROUP, NOD, dictionary and model-space entity identities, then inspected the retained standard-object evidence. Instrumentation was removed; no fixture or test dependency was added.
libdxfrwSourceProfileRecheck.specCrossCheck: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.72 specifies the R13–R14 GROUP object size and reactor count followed by the common parent/reactor/extension-dictionary references and the ordered group-member references. §§20.4.1–20.4.2 define the corresponding legacy entity common fields and handle roles. This supports inspecting the bounded in-frame parse; it does not by itself validate libdxfrw’s Unknown capture marker or resolve the dictionary text issue.
libdxfrwSourceProfileRecheck.disposition: Not output-ready. Although source identities, ordered members, typed baselines and payload matches are established, the selected projection admission gate rejected the DICTIONARY and GROUP frames because common-link evidence is Unknown; the DICTIONARY also carries UnknownCodePage text issue mask 0x8. No selected serialization/readback was attempted. Do not clear the marker, relax standardSourceEligible, or infer support from the imported typed values.

eedCodepageZeroDiagnostic.method: A temporary diagnostic around decodeEedString logged unrecognized per-value codepages while importing the source. The instrumentation was removed after the trace; no source or test change remains.
eedCodepageZeroDiagnostic.observation: The trace contains EED strings with per-value codepage 0 and varying byte counts across the drawing. It does not yet bind the DICTIONARY handle 0xD issue to a particular EED value or prove the meaning of codepage 0.
eedCodepageZeroDiagnostic.authorityReview: ODA v5.4.1 chapter 28 describes the per-value codepage field and framing, but the reviewed text does not define codepage 0 as inheriting the file codepage. LibreDWG's file-header codepage-0 fallback is not evidence for EED per-value semantics.
eedCodepageZeroDiagnostic.disposition: Keep the DICTIONARY text issue and both common-link eligibility gates closed. Do not map codepage 0 to the file codepage or clear UnknownCodePage absent field-bound source bytes plus normative or independent producer evidence.
